note: PASS WITH TRANSCRIPTION CAVEATS. TEXT: the .sav has no variable labels on these items (only 'The Acculturation Index' on the first column) and no value labels anywhere; the wording is the SPSS column NAME itself, space-stripped, so word spacing was RESTORED by this project and the leading numbering ('TheAcculturationIndex1.', '@2.' ... '@10.') stripped. No terminal punctuation is added (the paper's quotes carry none). Three deliberate deviations: (a) item_01's name is cut at the 64-char cap ('...withChinesecultu'); the tail is from the paper's own verbatim quote 'I should behave in accordance with Chinese culture'. (b) item_10's name is cut at the cap ('...organizedbypeopleofmycoun'); completed to 'country' by this project on the parallel wording of items 8 and 9 ('from my country') -- anything the item said after 'country' is unrecoverable and is not shipped. (c) item_06's column name reads 'Ishouldattachedtomyoriginalculture' (ungrammatical, no 'remain'), while the paper quotes this exact 'keep' item as 'I should remain attached to my original culture'; the paper's quote is the study's own explicit rendering of the item and ships, the variable-name form is recorded here. MAPPING (data_labels for the words, but POSITIONAL code derivation, so not exempt): the script assigns item_01..item_10 to ACCULT_IDX = range(49,59) via f'item_{i+1:02d}'. verify_luo_2021_acculturation_index.R shows every item's live 5-cell distribution equals the .sav column at the claimed position (50 of 50 cells, e.g. item_01 25/38/38/76/52, item_09 12/25/40/49/103, item_10 20/27/32/49/101) and the ten source vectors are pairwise distinct, so only the claimed assignment fits. Corroborated by the authors' own derived columns: hostcultualidentificationsum equals the sum of positions 50-54 and originalcultualidentificationsum the sum of 55-59 for 229/229 respondents, i.e. items 1-5 are 'adopt' and 6-10 'keep', consistent with item content. OPTIONS: paper states 'a 5-point Likert-type scale ranging from 1 (strongly disagree) to 5 (strongly agree)'; points 2-4 are labelled nowhere, so option_text is blank for them. INSTRUCTIONS: none published in paper or deposit; blank. STEP 3b NAME DISCREPANCY: the table name and dictionary Description ('10-item Acculturation Index') follow the deposit's block header, but the paper says the measure 'was adapted from Adopt and Keep scale developed by Swaidan et al.' -- these are not Ward & Kennedy's (1994) Acculturation Index items (which ask about similarity to host/co-nationals across life domains). The instrument field names the Adopt and Keep adaptation and records the deposit label; the dictionary Description may want correcting. The live data is the right block (10 items, resp 1-5; the other blocks in the file are 12-item 1-7 ECR-S and 4-item 1-4 support batteries). LANGUAGE: English administration (English-language questionnaire columns, English/Chinese proficiency measured as covariates), no _translated columns. RIGHTS: instrument_rights_register.csv has no Adopt and Keep / Swaidan row. Swaidan et al. published the scale in a journal article; no rights-holder page, fee, permission, NC, ND or no-redistribution clause could be located or quoted, so silence is permission. The shipped wording is moreover the study's own China-specific adaptation printed in its CC BY 4.0 PLOS deposit. No register row written (a round may not write ship).
